english.title: Slaughterhouse operator fail to destroy pig carcase and offal following disease infection
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..), failed, following the slaughter of pigs where the Chief Veterinary Officer was satisfied that disease was present at the slaughterhouse, to destroy the carcases and offal of infected pigs, pigs that a veterinary inspector suspected may have been infected with disease and pigs contaminated through contact with an infected pig or carcase
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 19(5)(a) and 39(1)(e) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
